The two are never merged. All intent fields remain null because no intended ASIN, listing URL, confirmation date or source was ever supplied; the owner fills them after confirming in Associates Central. Amazon's ASIN definition provides the checkable identifier: https://sellercentral.amazon.com/gp/help/external/G200386250
_recheckNote: Re-observation only. The recheck field records what the submitted short link resolved to when re-opened later the same day. It does not overwrite the observed* fields: both observations stand, each dated. Four of five rechecks landed on the Amazon home page instead of the product page recorded earlier the same day; one reproduced exactly. Cause unknown (possibly session- or bot-mitigation-dependent). This does not assert the short links are invalid — their compliance status remains unresolved in FLG-003. The site does not depend on them.
